headline: Nikhil Khandelwal files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Nikhil Khandelwal has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Systematix Corporate Services Limited.
detail: Nikhil Khandelwal has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, in connection with Systematix Corporate Services Limited. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when an acquirer crosses prescribed shareholding thresholds or announces an acquisition intention. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure and activates the target board's obligations under Regulation 3(5) to issue a response, typically within 10 days, and convene a shareholder meeting for approval within 4 weeks.
